description_html:
Key Features

  • Spacious Accommodation: Offers 21 comfortable sleeping berths, ideal for group diving trips or extended stays.
  • Climate-Controlled Environment: Maintains a consistent indoor temperature of 22°C, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere regardless of outdoor conditions.
  • Exclusive Dive Lodge Experience: Located 34 kilometers from the nearest road, providing a secluded and tranquil setting for divers seeking privacy and immersion in nature.
  • Flexible Booking: Minimum stay requirement of 2 nights, allowing guests to plan short getaways or longer retreats.
  • Seasonal Availability: Open for 4 months each year, aligning with optimal diving conditions and local weather patterns.
  • Custom Pricing: Nightly rates are determined after booking acceptance, offering tailored pricing based on group size and stay duration.

Main Benefits

  • Ideal for Divers: Designed specifically for diving enthusiasts, this lodge provides direct access to unique halocline dive sites, enhancing your underwater adventure.
  • Comfort and Convenience: With temperature control and ample sleeping space, guests enjoy restful nights and comfortable communal areas after each dive.
  • Secluded Location: The remote setting minimizes distractions and maximizes opportunities for relaxation, wildlife observation, and uninterrupted diving experiences.
  • Flexible Stays: The 2-night minimum allows for both brief escapes and extended explorations, making it suitable for various travel plans.
  • Personalized Value: Custom nightly rates ensure guests receive competitive pricing based on their specific needs and preferences.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Group Diving Expeditions: Perfect for dive clubs, research teams, or friends seeking a dedicated base for multi-day diving trips in halocline environments.
  • Nature Retreats: Appeals to travelers looking for a peaceful, off-the-grid stay with unique aquatic experiences.
  • Seasonal Adventures: Best suited for bookings during the 4-month open period, when diving conditions are at their peak.
  • Comfortable Remote Stays: Ideal for guests who prioritize comfort, climate control, and spacious accommodation in a secluded natural setting.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is the lodge suitable for large groups? Yes, with 21 berths, it accommodates both small and large parties comfortably.
  • What is the indoor climate? The lodge maintains a steady 22°C for guest comfort.
  • How remote is the location? Situated 34 km from the nearest road, it offers a true escape from urban life.
  • What are the booking requirements? A minimum stay of 2 nights is required, with tailored nightly rates provided after booking acceptance.
  • When can I book? The lodge is available for reservations during its 4-month open season, coinciding with the best local diving conditions.
